check_profanity.description: Check whether a text contains swear words or other profanity, to hold a post for review or branch a workflow. Common disguises such as sh1t and $hit count too.
check_profanity.display_str_template: Check text for profanity with PurgoMalum.
check_profanity.name: check_profanity

parameters.description: The text to check, such as a comment or a message, up to about 10,000 characters.
parameters.name: text

parameters.description: Up to 10 more words or phrases to treat as profanity, such as a competitor's name. Letters and spaces only.
parameters.name: extra_words_to_filter

clean_text.description: Mask the swear words and other profanity in a text, such as a comment before it is posted. Each word is filled with a character, or replaced whole with text you choose. Common disguises such as sh1t and $hit are caught too.
clean_text.name: clean_text

parameters.description: The text to check, such as a comment or a message, up to about 10,000 characters.
parameters.name: text

parameters.description: The character that fills each masked word, one for each letter.
parameters.name: replacement_character

parameters.description: Text that replaces each masked word whole instead, such as [removed]. Up to 20 letters, numbers, spaces or _ ~ ! - = | ' " * { } [ ] ( ).
parameters.name: replacement_text

parameters.description: Up to 10 more words or phrases to treat as profanity, such as a competitor's name. Letters and spaces only.
parameters.name: extra_words_to_filter

original_text.description: The text as it was given

text.description: The text with its profanity masked, without leading or trailing spaces

description: Filter profanity out of text with PurgoMalum, a free profanity filter: mask swear words with a character or your own text, add words of your own, or check whether a text is clean before it is posted.
